main_text.head: VIRIS Nobilissimis, Amplissimis, Consultissimis, Prudentissimis:
main_text.l: Dn. JOHANNI im Thurn / Domino in Theingen.
main_text.p: Ejusdem Reipubl. Senatoribus ac Scholarchis spectatissimis, cæterisque ejusdem ordinis, Ecclesiæ Scholæque Patriæ Præsidibus ac Inspectorib. longè dignissimis, &c.
main_text.head: VIRIS Reverendis, Clarissimis atq; Doctissimis Dominis,
main_text.l: Dn. THEODORO ZVINGERO, SS. Theol. D. V. T. Profess. ordinario, & Ecclesiæ Basil. Antistiti fidelissimo, dignissimo Domino suo venerando.
Dn. JOHANNI BUXTORFIO, SS. Theol. Doct. & Ling. Hebr. Prof. ac p. t. Facult. Phil. Dec. spectatissimo, Domino suo Præsidi, Fautori & Studiorum suorum Promotori colendo.
Dn. MELCHIORI HURTERO, Ecclesiæ Patriæ Decano emerito.
Dn. M. SAMUELI KESLERO, Verbi Divini in minori Basil. Ministro vigilantissimo, Domino Hospiti suo gratissimo.
main_text.p: Dominis suis Mæcenatibus, & Fautoribus, ThesES hasce Theologicas Submisse consecrat, & Offert JOHANNES MEISTERUS.

page.notes: The dedication is set in mixed roman, italic and capitals; the Latin "Dominis suis Mæcenatibus" and "Thefes hafce Theologicas" lines are italic in the scan. Several lines contain Gothic-style initial letters and swash capitals (e.g. "N" of Nobilissimis, "U" of Ut), transcribed as plain letters. Some words in the Thurn/Theingen lines are in a decorative type and may be imperfect.
